summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by WISeSat.Space Holdings Corp. (BVI-domiciled, non-US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) announcing completion of its business combination with Columbus Acquisition Corp. (CAC) on October 1, 2026, and a related $10 million PIPE by SEALSQ Corp. The press release was dated October 6, 2026; no per-share price, premium, or expected close is stated. The transaction closes with WISeSat ordinary shares expected to remain on Nasdaq. Watch for post-combination share overhang, PIPE lock-up terms, and Nasdaq listing compliance risk.
